notes: Static 200 Y x 150 X x 10 mm milled aluminium station. Four real through holes with 90-degree countersinks contain flush cross-drive screws. Yellow ST-02, the 60 mm flange outline, bore/bolt references and centre cross are surface print baked into the plate atlas, without raised decal geometry. The task-prescribed single box proxy fills the occupied screw holes. Station mass 0.80 kg and friction 0.35 are reasonable defaults because section 3.7 gives neither; fix the plate to the worktop in simulation. Metres, Z up, front -X; closed parts share the same prop frame, all transforms applied. Triangulated OBJ with normals, 30-degree smoothing and a nonoverlapping Smart UV 66-degree atlas. Each rigid part has a 2048-square, 8-bit sRGB albedo: CPU Cycles 64-sample DIFFUSE COLOR * (0.4 + 0.6 * AO), without direct light or highlights. Full Principled PBR is packed in source.blend. The 1024-square preview uses CPU Cycles 64, three lights, neutral grey and a front-left camera. Joint dynamics are integration parameters, not a claim of an executed robot episode. Generated with Blender 5.2.0 LTS. Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 6 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification. Task 13 delivery: baked albedos are Lanczos-downsampled to at most 1024 px except the unchanged-resolution factory-floor repeat tile; previews are 512 square. PNG encoding uses RGB8 or reviewed 256-colour Floyd-Steinberg palettes; source artwork pixels and source.blend are retained. Shared PNG paths resolve from this prop folder.
